paragraphs.text: translated by
1. WAKE with one mind, my friends, and kindle Agni, ye who are many and who dwell together.
paragraphs.original: उद्बुध्यध्वं समनसः सखायः समग्निमिन्ध्वं बहवः सनीळाः ।
paragraphs.translit: udbudhyadhvaṃ samanasaḥ sakhāyaḥ samagnimindhvaṃ bahavaḥ sanīḷāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Agni and Dadhikras and Dawn the Goddess, you, Gods with Indra, I call down to help us.
paragraphs.original: दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीमिन्द्रावतोऽवसे नि ह्वये वः
paragraphs.translit: dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīmindrāvato'vase ni hvaye vaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Make pleasant hymns, spin out your songs and praises: build ye a ship equipped with oars for transport.
paragraphs.original: मन्द्रा कृणुध्वं धिय आ तनुध्वं नावमरित्रपरणीं कृणुध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mandrā kṛṇudhvaṃ dhiya ā tanudhvaṃ nāvamaritraparaṇīṃ kṛṇudhvam |

paragraphs.text: Prepare the implements, make all things ready, and let the sacrifice, my friends, go forward.
paragraphs.original: इष्कृणुध्वमायुधारं कृणुध्वं प्राञ्चं यज्ञं प्र णयता सखायः
paragraphs.translit: iṣkṛṇudhvamāyudhāraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ pra ṇayatā sakhāyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Lay on the yokes, and fasten well the traces: formed is the furrow, sow the seed within it.
paragraphs.original: युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam |

paragraphs.text: Through song may we find bearing fraught with plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.
paragraphs.original: गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात्
paragraphs.translit: girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt

paragraphs.text: 4. Wise, through desire of bliss from Gods, the skillful bind the traces fast, And lay the yokes on either side.
paragraphs.original: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक् । धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया
paragraphs.translit: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak | dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā

paragraphs.text: 5. Arrange the buckets in their place securely fasten on the straps.
paragraphs.original: निराहावान्कृणोतन सं वरत्रा दधातन ।
paragraphs.translit: nirāhāvānkṛṇotana saṃ varatrā dadhātana |

paragraphs.text: We will pour forth the well that hath a copious stream, fair-flowing well that never fails.
paragraphs.original: सिञ्चामहा अवतमुद्रिणं वयं सुषेकमनुपक्षितम्
paragraphs.translit: siñcāmahā avatamudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanupakṣitam

paragraphs.text: 6. I pour the water from the well with pails prepared and goodly straps,
paragraphs.original: इष्कृताहावमवतं सुवरत्रं सुषेचनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: iṣkṛtāhāvamavataṃ suvaratraṃ suṣecanam |

paragraphs.text: Unfailing, full, with plenteous stream.
paragraphs.original: उद्रिणं सिञ्चे अक्षितम्
paragraphs.translit: udriṇaṃ siñce akṣitam

paragraphs.text: 7. Refresh the horses, win the prize before you: equip a chariot fraught with happy fortune.
paragraphs.original: प्रीणीताश्वान्हितं जयाथ स्वस्तिवाहं रथमित्कृणुध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: prīṇītāśvānhitaṃ jayātha svastivāhaṃ rathamitkṛṇudhvam |

paragraphs.text: Pour forth the well with stone wheel, wooden buckets, the drink of heroes, with the trough for armour.
paragraphs.original: द्रोणाहावमवतमश्मचक्रमंसत्रकोशं सिञ्चता नृपाणम्
paragraphs.translit: droṇāhāvamavatamaśmacakramaṃsatrakośaṃ siñcatā nṛpāṇam

paragraphs.text: 8. Prepare the cow-stall, for there drink your heroes: stitch ye the coats of armour, wide and many.
paragraphs.original: व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्म सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि ।
paragraphs.translit: vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varma sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni |

paragraphs.text: Make iron forts, secure from all assailants let not your pitcher leak: stay it securely.
paragraphs.original: पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहता तम्
paragraphs.translit: puraḥ kṛṇudhvamāyasīradhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroccamaso dṛṃhatā tam

paragraphs.text: 9. Hither, for help, I turn the holy heavenly mind of you the Holy Gods, that longs for sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: आ वो धियं यज्ञियां वर्त ऊतये देवा देवीं यजतां यज्ञियामिह ।
paragraphs.translit: ā vo dhiyaṃ yajñiyāṃ varta ūtaye devā devīṃ yajatāṃ yajñiyāmiha |

paragraphs.text: May it pour milk for us, even as a stately cow who, having sought the pasture, yields a thousand streams.
paragraphs.original: सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः
paragraphs.translit: sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Pour golden juice within the wooden vessel: with stone-made axes fashion ye and form it.
paragraphs.original: आ तू षिञ्च हरिमीं द्रोरुपस्थे वाशीभिस्तक्षताश्मन्मयीभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā tū ṣiñca harimīṃ drorupasthe vāśībhistakṣatāśmanmayībhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Embrace and compass it with tenfold girdle, and to both chariot-poles attach the car-horse.
paragraphs.original: परि ष्वजध्वं दश कक्ष्याभिरुभे धुरौ प्रति वह्निं युनक्त
paragraphs.translit: pari ṣvajadhvaṃ daśa kakṣyābhirubhe dhurau prati vahniṃ yunakta

paragraphs.text: 11. Between both poles the car-horse goes pressed closely, as in his dwelling moves the doubly-wedded.
paragraphs.original: उभे धुरौ वह्निरापिब्दमानोऽन्तर्योनेव चरति द्विजानिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ubhe dhurau vahnirāpibdamāno'ntaryoneva carati dvijāniḥ |

paragraphs.text: Lay in the wood the Soviran of the Forest, and sink the well although ye do not dig it.
paragraphs.original: वनस्पतिं वन आस्थापयध्वं नि षू दधिध्वमखनन्त उत्सम्
paragraphs.translit: vanaspatiṃ vana āsthāpayadhvaṃ ni ṣū dadhidhvamakhananta utsam

paragraphs.text: 12. Indra is he, O men, who gives us happiness: sport, urge the giver of delight to win us strength
paragraphs.original: कपृन्नरः कपृथमुद्दधातन चोदयत खुदत वाजसातये ।
paragraphs.translit: kapṛnnaraḥ kapṛthamuddadhātana codayata khudata vājasātaye |

paragraphs.text: Bring quickly down, O priests, hither to give us aid, to drink the Soma, Indra Son of Nistigri.
paragraphs.original: निष्टिग्र्यः पुत्रमा च्यावयोतय इन्द्रं सबाध इह सोमपीतये
paragraphs.translit: niṣṭigryaḥ putramā cyāvayotaya indraṃ sabādha iha somapītaye
